name: CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY
summary: Introduced OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY (CSV), which uses sequence numbers to enforce relative time-locks on transaction outputs. Essential for trustless off-chain protocols like the Lightning Network.
summaryZh: 引入了 OP_CHECKSEQUENCEVERIFY（CSV），使用序列号对交易输出强制执行相对时间锁定。对闪电网络等无信任链下协议至关重要。
